name: @dbcanvas/mcp-server
description: MCP Server for SQL database inspection - used by Claude, Cursor, Codex, Antigravity

scripts.bundle: npm run build && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=build/bundle.mjs --external:sqlite3 --external:better-sqlite3 --external:tedious --external:pg-native --external:mysql --external:mysql2 --external:oracledb --external:pg-query-stream --banner:js='import { createRequire } from "module"; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);'
